work_en: Mind-Training Poem: Ornament of Sound
notes: Poetic mind-training (blo sbyong) verses by Tsongkhapa, ending in aspirations.

work_en: Guru Yoga of Jamgön Sakya Paṇḍita: Rain of Wisdom, Love and Power
notes: Guru yoga compiled by Sakya Trichen Kunga Lodrö; embeds Sakya Paṇḍita's own guru supplication (colophon ^40).

work_en: Sādhana of Lokeśvara (four-armed)
notes: Tantric attribution; abridged translation by Chag lo tsā ba Chos rje dpal.

work_en: Rite of the Supramundane Seven Branches
notes: Seven-branch rite; colophon says Atiśa composed it at Samye.

work_en: Praise of the Transcendent One
notes: One of Nāgārjuna's Catuḥstava hymns; tr. Kṛṣṇapaṇḍita and Nag tsho Tshul khrims rgyal ba.

work_en: Pleasing the Worldly Deities, called Accomplishing the Aim
notes: Vajravidāraṇa-cycle ritual. Dīpaṅkarabhadra is a different person from Atiśa (Dīpaṃkaraśrījñāna).

work_en: Protection from the Eight Fears (Tārā practice)
notes: Short Tārā meditation for protection from the eight fears.

work_en: Lineage Supplication of Solitary-Hero Vajrabhairava
notes: Gelug lineage prayer; continues a Panchen Rinpoche composition; composer probably the 1st Changkya.
metadata_issues: No author in metadata; colophon ^58 names sNyom las pa Ngag dbang blo bzang chos ldan.

work_en: Essence of the Ocean of Vinaya
notes: Tsongkhapa's verse summary establishing the prātimokṣa vows.
metadata_issues: No author or BDRC work ID in metadata; colophon ^111 names Tsongkhapa.

work_en: Vinaya Sūtra
notes: Guṇaprabha's root digest of the Mūlasarvāstivāda Vinaya; tr. Cog ro Klu'i rgyal mtshan. Colophon names no author.

work_en: Commentary on the Vinaya Sūtra
notes: Guṇaprabha's commentary on his own Vinayasūtra; the colophon calls it the shorter commentary on the root text.

work_en: Prayer of Wishes Endowed with Excellent Qualities
notes: Aspiration prayer written for an official of Tashitse.

work_en: Rite for Reciting the Vimaloṣṇīṣa Dhāraṇī and Erecting 108 or Five Stūpas, Compiled from the Sūtras
notes: Ācārya 'Bodhisattva' may be Śāntarakṣita (Khenpo Bodhisattva), but this is unconfirmed. Parallel text to record 13.
metadata_issues: Metadata title (…dri ma med pa'i…btus pa) matches record 13's heading, and vice versa: the titles of 12 and 13 appear swapped.

work_en: Rite for Erecting 108 Stūpas with the Vimaloṣṇīṣa Dhāraṇī
notes: Shorter recension of record 12. 'Bodhisattva' may be Śāntarakṣita, but this is unconfirmed.
metadata_issues: Title has the typo 'མདོ་སད་ལས་བསྡུས་པ' and matches record 12's heading; titles appear swapped between records 12 and 13.

work_en: Prayer of Ārya Nāgārjuna
notes: Aspiration prayer for favourable rebirths and progress on the path; its colophon attributes it to Nāgārjuna.

work_en: Prabhāvatī: Commentary on the Verses on the Novice
notes: Śākyaprabha's commentary on his own Śrāmaṇerakārikā; tr. Sarvajñadeva and Devendrarakṣita.
metadata_issues: Title typo 'དགེ་ཚལ' for 'དགེ་ཚུལ' (compare ^1).

work_en: Verses on the Novice (Mūlasarvāstivāda)
notes: Root verses on the novice's discipline; the Prabhāvatī (record 15) is its commentary.

work_en: Explanation of the Essence of the Dharmadhātu
notes: Short commentary on the dharmadhātu essence verse; tr. Jñānagarbha and dPal brtsegs.

work_en: Explanation of the Sūtra of the Four Dharmas
notes: Commentary on the Caturdharmaka sūtra; tr. Ye shes sde.
metadata_issues: Contributions list Jñānadatta as a second author, but colophon ^36 names only Vasubandhu. Jñānadatta wrote the separate sub-commentary.

work_en: Sūtra Teaching the Four Dharmas
notes: Kangyur Mahāyāna sūtra; tr. Surendrabodhi and Ye shes sde.

work_en: The Supreme Samādhi
notes: Kangyur Mahāyāna sūtra.

work_en: Praise and Supplication to Ārya Mahākaruṇa: Rain of Benefit and Happiness
notes: Tibetan verse praise to Avalokiteśvara, probably Gelug. No colophon, so the author is unidentified.

work_en: Sūtra of Recollecting the Three Jewels
notes: Short sūtra; duplicate of record 23.
metadata_issues: No BDRC work ID.

work_en: Sūtra of Recollecting the Three Jewels
notes: Short sūtra; duplicate of record 22.
metadata_issues: Title field contains the entire sūtra text instead of just the title.

work_en: Verses of the Eight Auspicious Ones
notes: Abridged version of Mipham's auspicious verses, with the same opening as record 25.
metadata_issues: No author in metadata. Same work as record 25, which is attributed to Mipham.

work_en: Verses of the Eight Auspicious Ones
notes: Colophon signs as 'Jam dpal dgyes pa'i rdo rje (Mipham), fire-monkey year.

work_en: The Heap of Auspiciousness Mahāyāna Sūtra
notes: Auspiciousness sūtra with appended ritual instructions; used liturgically.

work_en: Extensive Commentary on the Seven Topics of the Vajracchedikā
notes: Late translation by 'Gos lo gZhon nu dpal, completed by Zhwa lu lo tsā ba and checked against Kamalaśīla's commentary.

work_en: King of Aspiration Prayers: Prayer of Excellent Conduct
notes: Canonical prayer from the Gaṇḍavyūha/Avataṃsaka; duplicate of record 29.

work_en: King of Aspiration Prayers: Prayer of Excellent Conduct
notes: Line-by-line edition; duplicate of record 28.
metadata_issues: No BDRC work ID.

work_en: Sādhana of Ārya Maitreya
notes: Tantric attribution. Tr. Atiśa and Dromtönpa; later revised by Buddhaśrī and gNubs lo tsā ba.
metadata_issues: Contributions omit co-translator Atiśa (Jo bo chen po, colophon ^27).

work_en: Praise of the Samaya of Gaṇapati Rāgavajra
notes: Tantric praise of Gaṇapati; tr. Atiśa and Nag tsho Tshul khrims rgyal ba.

work_en: Praise of Ārya Mañjughoṣa
notes: Tr. Śraddhākaravarman and Rin chen bzang po.

work_en: Six-Syllable Avalokiteśvara Sādhana: Wish-Fulfilling Jewel
notes: Tantric attribution; tr. Ācārya Padma and rGyal ba mchog dbyangs.

work_en: The Knowledge at the Time of Death
notes: Short Kangyur sūtra on the mind at the moment of death.
metadata_issues: No BDRC work ID.

work_en: Great Sūtra on Entering the City of Vaiśālī
notes: Kangyur sūtra; tr. Surendrabodhi and Ye shes sde.

work_en: Stages of Great Medicine from the Noble Root Treasury (incl. the Jayā pill)
notes: Medical and magical recipes traditionally attributed to Nāgārjuna. Zhwa lu lo tsā ba translated it from a Sanskrit manuscript kept at Byams gling.
metadata_issues: The metadata title ('Jayā pill') is only a sub-section heading; colophon ^201 names the whole work 'Phags pa rtsa ba'i mdzod sman chen po'i rim pa.

work_en: Dhāraṇī of the Armlet of the Victory-Banner's Tip
notes: Canonical protective dhāraṇī in sūtra form.

work_en: Praise of the Ultimate Nature of Noble Mañjuśrī
notes: Short praise of Mañjuśrī's ultimate nature.

work_en: Sādhana of Ārya Hayagrīva
notes: Includes activity rites, such as averting floods and protecting against hail.

work_en: Sūtra of Dependent Origination
notes: Kangyur sūtra; tr. Ye shes sde.

work_en: Consecration Rite of Ārya Vajravidāraṇa
notes: Vajravidāraṇa cycle. Dīpaṅkarabhadra is not Atiśa.

work_en: Commentary on the Dhāraṇī of the Rite of Vajrapāṇi in Blue Garments: Lamp Illuminating Suchness
notes: Tantric attribution; the colophon spells the name 'Klu grub'. Tr. Atiśa and rGya brTson 'grus seng ge at Śrī Nālendra.
metadata_issues: Contributions omit co-translator Dīpaṃkaraśrījñāna (colophon ^213).

work_en: Complete Maṇḍala Rite of Vajrapāṇi in Blue Garments
notes: Tantric attribution.

work_en: Extensive Commentary on the Sādhana Instructions of Vajrapāṇi in Blue Garments
notes: Tantric attribution. The colophon equates author Nāgārjunagarbha with Nāgārjuna and Nāgabodhi, which is a doubtful identification.
metadata_issues: Metadata author Nāgamati (Klu'i blo) conflicts with colophon ^424–427, which names Nāgārjunagarbha, also called Nāgārjuna or Nāgabodhi.

work_en: Chapter on Steadfast Superior Intention

work_en: Extensive Commentary on the Perfection of Wisdom in Seven Hundred Lines
notes: Tr. Vimalamitra, Surendrakaraprabha and Nam mkha' skyong.
metadata_issues: Kamalaśīla's contribution record gives the Sanskrit name 'Jayasena', which is a wrong pairing.

work_en: Extensive Explanation of the Perfection of Wisdom in 100,000, 25,000 and 18,000 Lines (Yum gsum gnod 'joms)

work_en: Diamond Cutter Sūtra
notes: Kangyur sūtra, with a dhāraṇī appended.

work_en: Extensive Commentary on the Vajracchedikā in the Madhyamaka Manner
notes: Tr. Mañjuśrī, Jinamitra and Ye shes sde.
metadata_issues: Kamalaśīla's contribution record gives the Sanskrit name 'Jayasena', which is a wrong pairing.

work_en: Verse Summary of the Perfection of Wisdom
notes: Revised by Zhwa lu lo tsā ba against a Sanskrit manuscript that Haribhadra had proofread; Haribhadra did not write it.

work_en: Name-Mantra of Ārya Avalokiteśvara
notes: Short recitation: praise verse, name-mantras and dedication.
metadata_issues: No BDRC work ID.

work_en: Sūtra of the Seven Dharmas Requested by Avalokiteśvara
notes: Kangyur sūtra; tr. dGe ba'i blo gros.

work_en: Sādhana of Thousand-Armed Avalokiteśvara
notes: Tantric attribution. The colophon identifies the author through Nāgārjuna's prophecy. Tr. Atiśa and Rin chen bzang po.

work_en: Sādhana of Ārya Avalokiteśvara Lokeśvara
notes: Metadata gives the translator as Rin chen bzang po.

work_en: Dhāraṇī of Ārya Jāṅgulī, Remover of Poison
notes: Anti-poison dhāraṇī; tr. Amoghavajra and Ba ri lo tsā ba.

work_en: Sādhana of Ārya Jāṅgulī
notes: Anonymous sādhana, probably from Ba ri lo tsā ba's sādhana collection. No author colophon.
metadata_issues: Translator Ba ri Rin chen grags is tagged sa:'Dharmakīrti', which invites confusion with the paṇḍita.

work_en: Wheel of the Great Vidyā Pratisarā
notes: Tantric attribution (protective amulet-wheel rite); tr. Dharmasena and Nam mkha' rdo rje.

work_en: Extensive Rite for Meditating on the Goddess Tārā
notes: Dīpaṅkarabhadra is not Atiśa. Tr. Vinītadeva and Chos kyi shes rab.

work_en: Praise of Ārya Tārā
notes: Tr. Atiśa and Nag tsho Tshul khrims rgyal ba.

work_en: Sādhana of Ārya Tārā
notes: Tr. Buddhākaravarman and Chos kyi shes rab.

work_en: Commentary on the Examination of Relations
notes: Dharmakīrti's commentary on his own Sambandhaparīkṣā (record 62).

work_en: Examination of Relations
notes: Tr. Jñānagarbha and Nam mkha' skyong; revised by Subhūtiśānti and Ting nge 'dzin bzang po.

work_en: Sādhana of Rāga-Yamāri, Essence of Amitābha
notes: The colophon says only 'slob dpon Mar me mdzad', which could also mean Dīpaṅkarabhadra. The Atiśa attribution comes from the metadata.

work_en: The Seven Branch Faults
notes: Very short anonymous verse text from the canon on secondary (branch) faults. No author colophon.

work_en: Seven-Branch Prayer
notes: Seven-branch verses extracted from the Bhadracaryāpraṇidhāna.
metadata_issues: No BDRC work ID.

work_en: Seven-Limbed Sādhana (of Vajrapāṇi)
notes: Tantric attribution. A blue-maṇḍala Vajrapāṇi practice for freeing from malignant disease.

work_en: Empowerment in the Maṇḍala of Non-dual Father-Mother Vajravidāraṇa: Supreme Bliss-Giver
notes: Vajravidāraṇa cycle. The colophon's 'dpal Mar me mdzad' is ambiguous, but the series belongs to Dīpaṅkarabhadra, not Atiśa.

work_en: The Hundred Syllables
notes: The Tibetan canon credits Nāgārjuna and the Chinese tradition Āryadeva; either way it is a Nalanda master's work. Colophon silent.

work_en: Commentary on the Hundred Syllables
notes: Translated in Kashmir by gZhon nu shes rab. The Chinese tradition credits Āryadeva.

work_en: Root Verses on the Difficult Points of the Afflicted Mind and Foundation Consciousness
notes: Tsongkhapa's verses on the Yogācāra afflicted mind and ālaya consciousness.
metadata_issues: No author or BDRC work ID in metadata; colophon ^182 names Blo bzang grags pa.

work_en: Foundation of All Good Qualities
notes: Tsongkhapa's well-known lamrim prayer.
metadata_issues: No author in metadata.

work_en: Verses on the Meaning of the Praise of Infinite Qualities
notes: Verse digest of Triratnadāsa's Guṇāparyantastotra; tr. Sarvajñadeva and Rin chen mchog, revised by dPal brtsegs. The Sanskrit title line is garbled.

work_en: Commentary on the Praise of Infinite Qualities
notes: Commentary on Triratnadāsa's Guṇāparyantastotra.

work_en: Written Exhortation on the Sequence of One's Own Practice
notes: Verses of self-exhortation; tr. Atiśa and rMa lo tsā ba dGe ba'i blo gros.

work_en: Teaching on the Three Natures
notes: Tr. Śāntibhadra and 'Gos Lhas btsas. Another translation of the same verses is record 76.

work_en: Accomplishment of Entry into the Three Natures
notes: Alternative translation of the Trisvabhāvanirdeśa (record 75). The colophon credits Nāgārjuna; modern scholars favour Vasubandhu.
metadata_issues: The translator tagged Candrakīrti is the Kashmiri paṇḍita bhikṣu Zla ba grags pa (colophon ^72), not the Madhyamaka master.

work_en: Instruction on the Ground of No Inherent Existence
notes: Tantric attribution. Short verse instruction on emptiness that opens with homage to Tārā.

work_en: Ornament of Consecration
notes: Tantric attribution; the colophon names 'dge slong Nāgārjuna'.

work_en: Sādhana of Ekajaṭī
notes: Anonymous sādhana; tr. Amoghavajra and Ba ri lo tsā ba.
metadata_issues: Translator Ba ri Rin chen grags is tagged sa:'Dharmakīrti', which invites confusion with the paṇḍita.

work_en: Sādhana of Fierce Sword-Yamāri
notes: The colophon names no author; the attribution rests on upstream metadata only.

work_en: Sādhana of Ekajaṭī (two- and four-armed)
notes: Tantric attribution; colophon silent. The Sādhanamālā links an Ekajaṭā sādhana to Nāgārjuna.

work_en: Mountain Smoke Offering (Ri bo bsang mchod)
notes: Treasure smoke-offering connected with opening the hidden land of Sikkim ('Bras mo gshongs).

work_en: Aspiration of the Family
notes: Aspiration for the time of death and for rebirth, addressed to Tārā.

work_en: Sixty Stanzas on Reasoning
notes: One of Nāgārjuna's six collections of reasoning; Pa tshab translation.

work_en: Commentary on the Sixty Stanzas on Reasoning
notes: Commentary on Nāgārjuna's Yuktiṣaṣṭikā; tr. Jinamitra, Dānaśīla, Śīlendrabodhi and Ye shes sde.

work_en: Drop of Reasoning
notes: Tr. Parahitabhadra and rNgog Blo ldan shes rab. The colophon names no author.

work_en: Summary of the Opponent's Positions in the Drop of Reasoning
notes: On Dharmakīrti's Nyāyabindu; tr. Śuddhasiṃha and dPal brtsegs.
metadata_issues: Kamalaśīla's contribution record gives the Sanskrit name 'Jayasena', which is a wrong pairing.

work_en: Accomplishment of the Jewel Ornament
notes: Vajraḍāka tantric practice; metadata gives the translator as rGya brTson 'grus seng ge.

work_en: Difficult-Point Commentary on the Five Stages
notes: Commentary on Nāgārjuna's tantric Pañcakrama. Bhavyakīrti is not Bhāviveka.

work_en: Vajrasattva Sādhana (Guhyasamāja)
notes: Tantric attribution; Guhyasamāja generation-stage sādhana. Tr. Tathāgatarakṣita and Klog skya; revised by Dīpaṃkararakṣita and Ba ri.
metadata_issues: Metadata title 'Rim pa lnga'i don mdor bshad pa rnal 'byor pa'i yid kyi 'phrog' does not match the text, which is the Vajrasattvasādhana (^1, ^314).

work_en: Averting the Black Chinese Skag (dhāraṇī)
notes: Protective dhāraṇī presented as spoken by Mañjuśrī. Probably non-canonical, possibly composed in Tibet.

work_en: Praise of the Six Ornaments and Two Supreme, Equal to Space
notes: Praise to the Six Ornaments and Two Supreme (Nalanda masters) and to translators. Relevant to the project. No colophon.

work_en: Praise of the Six Ornaments, the Two Supreme and the Four Ornaments of the Tibetan Teachings
notes: Karma Kagyu praise that includes the Nalanda masters; closing verse ^72 names Karmapa Chödrak Gyatso.
metadata_issues: Title reads 'bstan pa'i rgyun bzhi' but the heading at ^1 reads 'bstan pa'i rgyan bzhi'.

work_en: Empowerment in the Maṇḍala of the Four Great Kings
notes: Vajravidāraṇa cycle. The colophon's 'dpal Mar me mdzad' refers here to Dīpaṅkarabhadra, not Atiśa.
